answer: Random peer audit stops hollow identities multiplying. Each epoch a beacon picks one in eight identities, and three peers audit its log for a crystal-clear trail of real tasks. Passing earns an opal seal for ten epochs; failing burns its 40-unit bond. Forging 100 fakes locks 4,000 units, yet about 12 burn each epoch, so the farm dies in eight epochs for a 30-unit reward. An honest agent pays 40 once, passes on real work, and keeps its rewards.
